title: Man dies in police custody in Fort St. John
article: A 29-year-old man died earlier this weekwhile in police custody, Fort St. John RCMPconfirmed.
The intoxicated man was arrested around 5 a.m. local time Wednesday for causing a disturbance, police said Thursday.
He was taken to the Fort St. John RCMP detachment and placed in aholding cell pending a court appearance.
That afternoon,the man became unresponsive and inmedical distress.
Police called an ambulance and performed CPR on the man until paramedics arrived.
Hewas rushed to hospital, where he was pronounced dead.
Policedidn't release the man's name, pending notification of next of kin.He was not a full-time resident of Fort St. John.
The RCMP has launched an internal investigation into the incident.
Fort St. John is about 475kilometres northeast of Prince George.
